title: Curly Message Format conformance defect catalogue
description: The deliberately wrong adapters a correct runner answers for. RUNNER.md in this package states what each defect pins and how a runner is audited against them.

format.description: The versioned identifier of the format the catalogue targets.

defect.description: One way an adapter can be wrong, and what a correct runner answers where it is.

id.description: Unique across the catalogue; the name a runner carries the defect under.

description.description: One sentence stating what the adapter does, in terms any host can carry out.

document.description: The document the section is a heading of. Omitted, it is SPEC.md; a defect of the tree names CST.md.

section.description: A heading number of the document named above: a section ("7"), a subsection ("9.2") or an appendix entry ("A.4").

expects.description: What a correct runner answers: it rejects the adapter's claims before anything runs, it fails a case, it leaves a case out, or it passes a case while saying the reports went unchecked.
